en.t: The morning rooster announced the dawn.

units.source_text: 随从们都起身，互相告道：“昨夜睡得真好。

en.t: The attendants all got up and said to one another, "We slept very well last night.
Let us quickly get the carriage ready."

units.source_text: 纪伊守也出来了，他说：“又不是女眷出门避凶。

en.t: The Governor of Kii also came out and said, "It is not as if a lady were going out to avoid an unlucky direction.

units.source_text: 公子回宫，用不着这么急急地在天色未明时动身！”

en.t: The young lord is only returning to the palace, so there is no need to set out in such haste before daybreak."

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“此种机会，不易再得。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "Such an opportunity will not be easy to have again.

units.source_text: 今后特地相访，怎么可行？

en.t: How could I possibly come to visit her deliberately in the future?

units.source_text: 传书通信，也是困难之事！”

en.t: Even sending letters and keeping in touch would be difficult."
Thinking this, he was overcome with heartache.

units.source_text: 侍女中将也从内室出来了，看见源氏公子还不放还女主人，心中万分焦灼。

en.t: The maid Chujo also came out from the inner room, and seeing that Prince Genji still would not let her mistress return, she was terribly anxious.

units.source_text: 公子已经许她回去，但又留住了，对她说：“今后我怎么和你互通音信呢？

en.t: The prince had already allowed her to go back, but then he kept her there again and said to her, "How shall I exchange messages with you from now on?

units.source_text: 昨夜之事，你那世间无例的痛苦之情，以及我对你的恋慕之心，今后便成了回忆的源泉。

en.t: What happened last night, your pain unlike anything in the world, and my longing love for you will become the source of memories from now on.

units.source_text: 世间哪有如此珍奇的事例呢？”

en.t: Where in the world could there be such a rare and strange example?"

units.source_text: 说罢，泪下如雨，这光景真是艳丽动人。

en.t: When he had finished speaking, tears fell like rain, and the sight was truly beautiful and moving.

units.source_text: 晨鸡接连地叫出，源氏公子心中慌乱，匆匆吟道：

en.t: As the morning roosters cried one after another, Prince Genji's heart grew flustered, and he hurriedly composed:
